title: Proton beam energy of record accelerators, 1931–2022
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale of the energy to which each machine accelerated protons, per proton. Lawrence and Livingston's first cyclotron, 1931: 80 keV. Lawrence's 60-inch cyclotron, 1939: 16 MeV. CERN's Super Proton Synchrotron, 1976: 400 GeV. Fermilab's Tevatron, 1986: 900 GeV. The Large Hadron Collider, 2022: 6.8 TeV per beam. The last two are colliders, whose two beams meet head on. Data: the Cyclotron, Super Proton Synchrotron, Tevatron and Large Hadron Collider articles, Wikipedia.
